properties.statement:
Read 2026-10-12, when Anthony said the site says nothing about one design by itself. site/index.html is titled "reflow2 — a project brain". Its opening line is "One shared design across all your repositories". Its sections are: Where the knowledge lives; What goes into the brain; One brain across all your repositories (each repository keeps its own graph, the hub links them); It gets smarter every time you use it; Try it. Its three made-up Gearheads scenarios (a motor failing at a competition, designing next season's climber, requirements changing) are told as uses of the brain. None of them follows one design from the first requirement to working code. site/hub.html is titled "a hub, or project brain", so the one phrase names both. site/setup.html says how to install and nothing about the work. So a reader meets reflow2 first as a multi-repository hub, and never meets the single-design case, which is how most people start (Anthony at work: one project, VS Code, --call). Observation only: no cause was walked, and nothing is decided. The open question is dec:idea-how-does-the-site-show-what-reflow2-is-for-one-design-by-itself. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

ALSO READ 2026-10-12, when Anthony said people take reflow2 for "AI" meant to replace people: the home page's only description of how it works is "Kept in a graph any AI agent can read, and updated as you work." It never says who decides, never names the partnership of human, model and graph that rule:reflow2-is-one-of-three-parts-and-does-not-compete-with-the-others and dec:three-party-checks settled, and does not link docs/partnership.md, which maps each known model failure mode (hallucination, overconfidence, memory) to its check. Measured on the source at the v0.83.3 cut: no crate depends on a model library, so reflow2 itself runs no AI. The site does not say that either. Observation only. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

CLOSED 2026-10-12 by reflow2 #734 (merged 8eccc72e4, chg:the-site-says-what-reflow2-is-and-is-not-in-plain-words-2026-10-12). The home page now opens on the partnership ("You decide. The AI helps. reflow2 remembers why."). It shows one design first, says reflow2 runs no AI of its own and who decides, links to a walkthrough of one design (site/walkthrough.html) and to why.html, and no longer calls one design a "project brain"; the phrase names only a hub. Everything above stays as written: it is what the site said before #734.
